Class AbandonedStationCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.AdventureCard
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.AbandonedStationCard
public class AbandonedStationCard extends AdventureCard
Represents an adventure card for an abandoned station encounter in the game. The behavior of this card includes drawing, checking requirements, managing landing decisions, applying effects tied to winning goods, and updating the game state accordingly based on the player's decisions and card effects. Inherits from AdventureCard.

    • checkRequirements

      public void checkRequirements()
      Checks if the current player meets the requirements to proceed with the abandoned station card action. The method evaluates the total number of crew members (including astronauts, brown aliens, and purple aliens) on the player's shipboard to determine whether the player can land on the station. If the number of crew members is equal to or greater than the required amount, it transitions the game state to allow the player to decide whether to land on the station or the ship. Otherwise, it moves to the next player.
      Overrides:
      checkRequirements in class AdventureCard

    • landingOnStationOrShip

      public void landingOnStationOrShip(boolean IsLanded) throws IllegalMethodOnThisStateException
      Handles the decision process for landing on a station or ship during the game. This method updates the game state and executes the appropriate actions based on whether the player decides to land or not.
      Overrides:
      landingOnStationOrShip in class AdventureCard
      Parameters:
      IsLanded - boolean indicating the player's decision to land on the station or ship. If true, the player lands; if false, the player skips the landing.
      Throws:
